openings.claim: Unequal context familiarity may impede entry independently of proficiency.
openings.discriminator: Shared-context prompts reduce entry latency and switching.
openings.probe: Alternate comparable prompts between groups; observe entry, switches, individual duration; privately ask optional familiarity.
openings.uncertainty: Entry friction versus unequal turns remains unresolved.

openings.claim: Fresh starts plus balanced turns may improve useful practice.
openings.discriminator: Timed speech without usefulness improvement weakens explanation.
openings.fit: Preserves routine; optional supports/extensions avoid labels.
openings.probe: Test self-contained prompts, alternating timed turns, scheduled partner changes and equal-turn trios; observe formation, turns, optional attendance frequency.
openings.uncertainty: Bundled causes and volunteer timing cost remain uncertain.

openings.claim: Temporal ambiguity may cause stale preparation answers.
openings.discriminator: Errors despite correct dates weaken explanation.
openings.fit: Six dated paper tasks; reissue with next date marked; tasks independent of attendance.
openings.probe: Ask date and task separately; log print-only results and calendar preparation cost.
openings.uncertainty: Advance topic selection and paper usability during absence untested.

openings.claim: One dated instruction may reduce confusion and recurring work.
openings.discriminator: Fewer stale answers and clarification minutes.
openings.fit: Reusable next-task sheet, matching printed master, immediate unprepared entry.
openings.probe: Count correct, stale, blank and missing answers; log printing and clarification separately.
openings.uncertainty: Recall/comprehension may dominate; next task must be ready.

decision: Test distinct alternatives over six sessions; no established cause. Preserve free entry despite absence, nonpreparation or declined public labels; offline access; conversational purpose; 75-minute room limit and unpaid facilitation. Check >=80% useful-practice reports, >=85% correct tasks and <90 weekly coordination minutes including setup. Use attendance denominators with blanks/missing visible; untimed, unlinked baseline slips cannot establish attendee-wide success.
